Each entry: attrs, keys (or unkept + one-line reason, task-status only), scope (text|phases|tasks|drill|usage), counts, on/reset/paint/encode/decode. Consumers: clearAll (date-range.js) = forEach reset+paint then refresh; syncHash (filters.js) loops encode() over keys, hash key order unchanged, v/so/th stay outside the registry; refresh: live = FILTER_AXES.filter(on), narrows = scope tasks, anyFilter = scope != usage, Clear shown when anything is live, fcount = live counts; restore (exports.js) = forEach decode(HASH) then paint. chips.js: each tf host carries __pid so the registry repaints the per-phase chips. authors.js: a second gap of the same class - an author pick called syncHash but never refresh, so Clear was never offered for the author axis; applyAuthor is now a painter only and both author handlers call refresh(). task-status now counts on fcount/anyFilter and offers Clear (requirement 3). tests/test_render_report.py: per-field pins removed (c3 au link/clear, d1 a link/clear/count, tv-r5, tv-r6) and replaced with _filter_axis_cases rx1-rx9 (registry declared once in page-state.js; every wireChips attribute is registered or in NOT_A_FILTER with a reason, checked both directions; attrs unique; every entry has all behaviours/scope/counts; keys-xor-unkept, keys unique; clearAll/syncHash/restore/refresh counters iterate FILTER_AXES and name no state variable, where the forbidden names are derived from each reset's assignments; no HASH.<registered key> anywhere; task-status counts). tools/check-report-interactive.mjs: cl0-cl9 'Clear lifts every axis' in its own browser context, controls derived by kind from the DOM (.sectools/.tf-chips/.auchips [aria-pressed], .sectools input, .gfilters input/select), each turned on alone on a fresh load, then Clear, then the page is checked against its load state (pressed, fcount, hash keys, audit-view-* storage, visible phases, field values), then again after a reload; it lists idle controls, controls not reachable in the default view, and wired attributes no control carries as not exercised.
